name: Custom Save Folders
description: Create custom save folders per game and apply them only for the current launch session.

ui.title: Custom Save Folders
ui.empty_selection: Select a game to manage its custom save folders.
ui.folder_item_hint: This folder will be applied after patching and restored when the game closes.
ui.current_game_hint: The selected folder is applied after mod patching and restored after the game closes.
ui.name_hint: Choose the name for the separate save folder that this game should use.
ui.delete_tooltip: Remove this folder from the plugin
ui.add_tooltip: Create a new custom save folder
ui.restored_status: Restored original data files after the custom save folder session.

dialogs.delete_body: "{name}" will only be removed from this plugin. Existing save folders on disk will stay untouched.

errors.name_too_long: The save folder name is too long.
errors.name_invalid_chars: The save folder name contains characters that are not safe for a save folder.
errors.name_invalid_suffix: The save folder name cannot end with a space or a dot.
errors.name_reserved: This save folder name is reserved by Windows.
errors.folder_exists: This save folder already exists for the selected game.
errors.game_path_missing: The selected game's folder is not configured.
errors.data_file_missing: Could not find a supported data file for {game}.
errors.script_missing: The custom save folder script is missing.
errors.apply_failed: Failed to apply the custom save folder: {error}
errors.restore_failed: Failed to restore original data files: {error}
